name: Logo Quiz in Japanese!
desc:
This game involves entering the name of the logo in Japanese in the chat and answering the questions to complete it.

The update allows you to answer questions using hiragana, katakana, and kanji input, as well as common abbreviations. Please note that incorrect answers may result from confusion between English and hiragana/katakana.

📸 Play logo quizzes from various genres! 
⭐ Complete as many challenges as possible and claim the rewards for completing them! 
🏆 Compete with others in the number of clears!
